svg.title: Chris Rader
svg.desc: Chris Rader: builder, product marketer, coach. A scorebook-style shipping log scrolls through 14 projects shipped between September 25 and October 24, 2026, from Recording-Atlas to github-readme-designer, and a stamp reads: shipped, 14 in 30 days.
svg.text: set the rules, and check the work.
VP of Product Marketing at Centercode by day.
Agent skills, apps and coaching tools on my own time.

g.text: READMEs that sell the project, with motion
teams of agents build rival takes; judges rank
interfaces drawn in living, full-color glyphs
Lighthouse reports into ranked, agent-ready fixes
checks what an auto shop's inspection claims
a stop-motion studio run from Claude Code
brick-built films; design docs so far
explains hard things with a coach's warmth
practice plans and drills for ages 4-12
grades a swing from phone video

calls into timelines and a coaching report
fees and sponsors across 37 Little Leagues
